scripts.features:
Ronix Hub, a universal multi-game script hub supporting 59 Roblox games.

Supported games include:
99 Nights in the Forest, ABA (Anime Battle Arena), Adopt Me!, Animal Hospital, Anime Dice, BedWars, Bee Swarm Simulator, Berry Avenue RP, Blade Ball, Blox Fruits, Blue Lock: Rivals, Break and Steal an Egg, Brookhaven RP, Build and Kill Zombies, Build the Pyramid!, Catalog Avatar Creator, Clean all the Leaves, Command An Army, Dandy's World, Evade, Fisch, Fish It!, Flee the Facility, Fling Things and People, Forsaken, Grow a Garden, Heavyweight Fishing, Huss Valley, Illegal Soccer, Jujutsu Shenanigans, Loot To Forge, Murder Mystery 2, Pet Simulator 99!, Ride A Pet, RIVALS, Sell Lemons, Slayers 2, +1 Speed Keyboard Escape, Steal a Brainrot, Steal An Egg, Storage Hunters, +1 Strength for Eggs, The Strongest Battlegrounds, Tower Defense Simulator, Troll Hug Tower, Violence District, Volleyball Legends, +1 Wings For Eggs.

Each game has its own tailored feature set (auto farm, ESP, speed, aimbot, auto collect, and more). Load the hub in any supported game to see available tools.
